verdict.rationale: stagewise's agent can run your dev server and preview the app (docs-11), drive browser tabs via CDP (docs-25), and take screenshots to debug visually (docs-12). It also has access to the tab's console and debugger (gh-3) and can run shell commands and scripts such as tests (docs-18), which together cover reproducing and verifying fixes, with diff review and undo for iterating on candidate fixes (docs-6, docs-9). Missing for 10: a documented end-to-end debugging or root-cause workflow (narrowing down causes is only implied by debugger access), explicit test-based fix verification guidance, coverage beyond web front-ends, and independent hands-on corroboration of debugging use.
